A [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] '''prison''' was located on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was being held there until she was [[Second mission to Tatooine|rescued]] by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]].
